meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 用户请求修复 bug 后，Claude 会诊断并复现缺陷，在临时工作区写最小修复和回归测试，再按归属交付：上游 Codex 缺陷开 fork PR，LazyCodex 相关缺陷发带补丁的修复 issue，均附复现与验证日志。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、贡献修复或为 bug 开 PR 等时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复这个 LazyCodex 的 bug
say.note: 会生成带补丁的修复 issue 并附上验证日志

say.text: 为这个 openai/codex 的 bug 开一个 PR
say.note: 会从 fork 分支创建 PR，附前后测试结果

say.text: 调试并修复这个 omo-codex 的问题
say.note: 会按仓库归属路由到对应交付形式

howto.what_en: On a bug-fix request, Claude debugs the issue, applies the smallest correct fix in a temp workspace, and delivers a fork PR (upstream Codex) or a verified-fix issue with patch (LazyCodex), with repro and verification logs.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, or open a PR for a bug, etc.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex bug and submit the fix.
say_en.note: It creates a verified-fix issue with patch and logs.

say_en.text: Open a PR for this openai/codex bug.
say_en.note: It will push a fork branch and create the PR with test results.

say_en.text: Debug and fix this omo-codex issue.
say_en.note: It will route to the right repo and deliver the fix.
